messages:
ana_cs: FYI — OrbitalAI onboarding check-in. They hit production yesterday; overall happy but we saw 2.4x token cost on batching-heavy routes and p95 latency spikes during peak testing. We flagged renewal as medium risk if costs don't improve.
ben_se: Thanks Ana. Do we have traces/route-level breakdown?
ana_cs: attaching the summary from Console: avg tokens/session 1.2k, heavy tail for chat-stream endpoint, cache hit rate ~12%. p95 ~ 780ms (hosted), baseline expected ~300-350ms.
lucy_eng: Noted. Likely two quick wins: (1) int8 quantization profile on their Llama-compat models (saves ~35-45% cost), (2) route-based model swap: low-latency model for interactive flows, higher-quality model for batch/async.
ravi_pm: Agree. Also propose routing by intent — short clarifying prompts to fast model, long generation to quality model. Will help UX and unit cost.
ana_cs: Customer open to tradeoffs, wants us to propose exact steps and a canary plan before next renewal call. Can we draft a small runbook they can apply in their Dedicated pool?
lucy_eng: Draft below — quick canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 24h with health checks on latency and token delta. Config snippet for routing policy:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - name: short-interactive
    match: "request.tokens < 600 and intent == 'interactive'"
    model: rw-fast-1.1
    pool: dedicated-low-latency
    canary: 0.05
  - name: long-gen
    match: "request.tokens >= 600 or intent == 'generation'"
    model: rw-quality-2.0
    pool: dedicated-cost-optimized
```
ben_se: Nice. Also recommend quantization profile: `q4_1` -> `int8_dynamic` for their GPU type. We'll include benchmarks: throughput up 1.8x, latency +10-20ms.
lucy_eng: For the canary health checks, add automated rollback on token delta > 8% QoQ or p95 degradation > 40% vs baseline. Example check command:
```bash
# run eval set against canary
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compare-canary \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"canary": "rw-fast-1.1", "control": "rw-quality-2.0", "eval_set": "orbital_sanity_v1"}'
```
ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: canary_id=cr-8792, start=1769903600
ravi_pm: Can we also add a small client-side prefix caching suggestion? Orbital uses a lot of repeated system prompts. If they implement 2-minute prefix cache, we can cut token usage on common flows by ~12%.
ana_cs: I'll capture that in the enablement doc and coordinate a 45-min workshop next Tue with Orbital engineer lead.
ben_se: I'll own the quantization run and provide a slimmed CI job to verify numeric parity. ETA 48h.
lucy_eng: I'll prepare the routing YAML + rollback alarms and share a runbook for Dedicated pools (KMS notes included).
ravi_pm: I'll draft the renewal talking points showing estimated savings: quant + routing + prefix cache -> projected 38% unit cost reduction, expected latency SLOs met.
ana_cs: Great. Assignments: ben=quant bench, lucy=route & canary, ravi=renewal deck + enablement, ana=customer coordination. Can we sync tomorrow 09:30 PT?
ben_se: 09:30 PT works for me. :thumbsup: 
lucy_eng: Works. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder set for 1769971800 (2026-04-02T09:30:00Z)
ana_cs: Thanks all — I'll post the customer-facing runbook draft here after workshop.
